title: Rewrite the Attention browser suite: press a row, get exactly that set
done_when: Every test stubs /api/ops/projects (PA-PF fixture) beside the summary stub; pressing each of the four rows lands on /ops2/projects listing exactly that predicate's fixture refs with the other rows' exclusive projects absent (assert listed row text, not chip state); row counts come from the rows fixture, not SUMMARY_STUB; a fixture change between visits moves both counts and lists on re-entry; a missing-predicate fixture draws no row; summary-ok + projects-500 draws attention-error with zero pressable rows; ?wait href assertions become ?attn; enquiries/trade destination tests and the customer-session unauthorised tests still pass.
